theme_rankings.why_now: AI가 돌아가려면 전기 필요. 미국 변압기 대기 100주+ → 만드는 회사들 5년치 일감 확보.
theme_rankings.risk: 사이클 후반 진입 우려는 아직 작지만, 금리 급등 시 인프라주 동반 조정.

theme_rankings.why_now: HBM4·CoWoS·EUV 모두 캐파 부족 지속. 2027까지 수요 가시성 확보된 영역.
theme_rankings.risk: 사이클 정점 논쟁 + 중국 수출 규제 변동성. 어닝 미스 시 30% 낙폭 흔함.

theme_rankings.why_now: MSFT·GOOG·META·AMZN 2026 Capex 합계 $400B+. AI 매출 회수 본격화 단계.
theme_rankings.risk: 광고·소비 둔화 시 Capex 가이던스 컷 가능. 빅테크 동반 변동성.

theme_rankings.tagline: 🚂 AI의 '밴더빌트' — 실제 업무에 AI 박는 운영자
theme_rankings.why_now: 추론 비용 90% 하락 + 엔터프라이즈 도입 본격. 진짜 텐베거 후보가 여기서 다수.
theme_rankings.risk: 밸류에이션 과열. 매출 성장 30%+ 못 보이면 멀티플 압축.

theme_rankings.why_now: 인지노동 다음은 물리노동. 2027~2030 진정한 텐베거 가능 영역.
theme_rankings.risk: 상용화 시점 불확실. 미래 옵션밸류 비중 큼. 변동성 극심.

theme_rankings.why_now: 강한 추세장에서만 사용. 분할매수 + 손절선 명확히 + 자산의 5~10% 이하.
theme_rankings.risk: 장기 보유 ❌. 횡보·하락장에선 음의 복리(volatility decay)로 손실 누적.

top_news.title: Gold Set for Worst Week Since March on Hawkish Fed, AI Selloff
top_news.summary: Gold fell for a fifth day — heading for the biggest weekly decline since March — as a hawkish Federal Reserve signaled more interest-rate hikes and a rout in AI stocks pushed investors to sell the metal to cover losses.

top_news.title: Stocks Sell Off as AI Trade Falters, Bonds Gain: Markets Wrap
top_news.summary: Global stocks were poised for their longest losing streak in more than three years as the artificial intelligence trade cratered after a bull run earlier this year, sending investors to the safety of haven assets such as Treasuries and the dollar.

top_news.title: US Sour Crude’s War Premium Vanishes as Oil Supply Surges
top_news.summary: The price of US sour oil has plunged, as a surge in crude supply from Venezuela, Canada and the Middle East gives refiners ample barrels to choose from.

top_news.title: Australian Pension Funds Confront Their Latest Rival: AI Agents
top_news.summary: Top Australian pension funds are grappling with the potential proliferation of autonomous AI agents, a new source of competition in the lucrative retirement market which senior executives say is creating significant challenges.

top_news.title: Trilateral Talks Yield Few Concrete Results
top_news.summary: Power dynamics were on full display as the leaders of the US, China, and Russia met on the sidelines of the APEC summit in Shenzhen. Presidents Donald Trump, Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin pledged to boost global fuel supplies and held discussions spanning issues from Ukraine to denuclearization. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: RBA Seeks to Manage Inflation, Jobs Tradeoffs, Board Member Says
top_news.summary: Australia’s central bank is trying to manage the difficult tradeoffs in monetary policy of how much weight to put on inflation and how much on employment, as required under its mandate, said Renee Fry-McKibbin, a member of the Reserve Bank’s rate-setting board.

top_news.title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Nov. 20
top_news.summary: Oil edged higher after a volatile session on Thursday, with futures on track for a third weekly decline as traders weigh the risk of renewed US strikes on Iran against ample supply.

top_news.title: China Sells $2 Billion Bonds at Same Yield as US Treasuries
top_news.summary: China sold $2 billion of dollar-denominated sovereign bonds on Thursday priced at no premium to US Treasuries, as the offering drew strong demand.

top_news.title: Japan Tobacco Shares Fall After Russia-Related Charges
top_news.summary: Japan Tobacco Inc. shares declined after the cigarette maker said it expects to swing to an operating loss and slashed its dividend forecast after losing control of its Russian business.

top_news.title: Fed Tells Regional Staff to Expect Lower Pay Hikes in 2027
top_news.summary: The Federal Reserve has warned employees at its regional outposts to expect lower pay increases next year, according to a memo viewed by Bloomberg News.
